title: Cluster 1 Hub Orchestration layer implemented — full Octo/Ozi/routing/launch stack built
signal: All 5 Cluster 1 hub-orchestration epics are now implemented: model routing table, provider grabber layer, intent-based spoke launch, Octo gardener dispatch, and Ozi spoke lug model. The hub now has: (1) a model routing table mapping work classes to model classes, (2) pluggable provider grabbers, (3) a launch CLI that routes user intent to spoke+model+startup-profile, (4) Octo as hub-level gardener that scans/dispatches via job queue, (5) canonical ozi-controller/work/test lug pattern for automation history. Cluster 2 (handles, product layer) is now unblocked.
rationale: This completes the hub-side orchestration stack. The framework can now route work intelligently, dispatch via Octo, and track automation history via lugs rather than opaque state. Cluster 2 builds on this foundation.
